public_rationale: The DALL-E 2 failure component holds: its own paper reports color-binding problems with stacked cubes. The broader dismissal overlooks an identified difference in Imagen's language encoder and evidence of improved alignment on challenging prompts. That is a principled reason to expect relevant differences. It does not demonstrate that Imagen solved compositionality, so the stronger reading of 'profoundly different' remains unsettled.
limitations: Mixed applies to the supported prior-failure component and the challenged dismissal of relevant architectural differences.
The comparative evidence comes from the model developers.
The result depends on treating demonstrated improvement as relevant, rather than requiring complete elimination of the failures.
